get_cuda_specs: get CUDA or HIP specifications including compute capability and version tuple
get_compute_capabilities: get a sorted list of GPU compute capabilities for all available CUDA devices
get_rocm_gpu_arch: get the ROCm GPU architecture string such as gfx900 or gfx1030
get_cuda_version_string: get the CUDA or HIP version as a compact string like 118 for 11.8
test_cuda_available: test whether CUDA is available and retrieve full GPU specifications
